DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_MAIN_1: おい待て、ひよっ子！お前に渡すものがある。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_MAIN_OPTION_1: そんなことより、上空の環を持つ惑星はあなたには見えてる？<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_RINGED_PLANET_1: 環を持つ惑星だって？いや、そんなもの見たことも聞いたこともない。変な夢かなにか見たんじゃないのか？<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_COMPASS_1: 今日は翻訳ツールが初めて現場に出るときだというのは知ってるが、この新しいオリエンテーリングツールも準備してきたから、お前に試してもらいたいんだ。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_COMPASS_2: こいつはシグナルスコープに似てるが、特にエキゾチックなエネルギー測定値を追跡するためのものだ。火でも放射線でも不気味な岩でも、なんでもいい。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_COMPASS_3: だが幽霊物質には使えない。あれは低濃度で大量に浮遊してるせいで、測定値が役に立たない。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_COMPASS_4: ツールが周波数に固定されると、それがどこであれ最も近い源を常に指し示す。私のような一日中同じ場所に留まってるやつにはあんまり役に立たないがな。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_OWLK_SAMPLE_1: そういえば、さっきRiebeckがこのガラクタの山を降ろしてきた。何か奇妙なNomaiの技術かもしれないと言ってたな。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_OWLK_SAMPLE_2: そいつが何であれ電磁放射の強い痕跡を発してるから、私らの“コンパス”を使ってさらに追跡できるかもしれない。<i></i>
DialogueDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_END_1: 私からはもう十分話したので、あとはお前に任せよう。この変わり者の年寄りに長々と話されるよりも、お前自身の目で確かめたいだろう。<i></i>

ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SHIP_SEEN: 目が覚めると、奇妙な環を持つ惑星が巨人の大海を周回しているのが見えた。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SHIP_SCAN: 環を持つ惑星に近づくと、緑色の光線が発射されて私を包み込んだ。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SHIP_FLEE: そこに触れる前に、環を持つ惑星は突然ワープして消えてしまった。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SHIP_ENTER: 私は気づくと夢のような場所にいて、そこでは生霊がさまざまなアイデアや概念を提示してきた。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SHIP_EXIT: 生霊の夢の中で特定の炎に近づいたところ、気づくと自身の探査艇の中に戻っていた。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_FRIEND_OR_FOE: 生霊は私に選択を迫った:恩人の遺体に向かって攻撃的に迫りくる私の姿か、それとも恩人と私が平和に手を取り合っている姿か。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SEEK_OR_FLEE: 私はさらに選択を迫られた:生霊とその恩人とともに宇宙の眼を探すか、あるいは両者を見捨てるか。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_SEEK_EYE: 私は彼らが宇宙の眼を探すのを手伝うことを選んだ。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_CRYSTAL_REVEALED: 生霊は、Nomaiが用いるものと似たある種の結晶を提示した。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_CRYSTAL_LAUNCH: 軌道探査砲から発射された探査機にはこの共鳴する結晶が1つ組み込まれている。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_CRYSTAL_RESONANCE: そのNomaiの結晶は宇宙の眼に反応して共鳴する。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_CRYSTAL_USAGE: 環を持つ惑星にもその結晶があれば宇宙の眼と共鳴するようになるだろう。
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_WRAITHS_REVEALED: The wraith presented a group of other wraiths whose bodies appear dim instead of glowing with energy.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_WRAITHS_SHORT_RANGE: In its current state, the ringed planet can warp around near the sun but not far enough to reach the Eye of the Universe.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_WRAITHS_TOWER: The tower in the dream world has something we need to free the other wraiths.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_WRAITHS_IMPRISONED: The other wraiths are being held in the basement of some sort of control room in the Stranger.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_WRAITHS_LONG_RANGE: Reuniting with the other wraiths will allow the ringed planet to warp far enough to reach the Eye of the Universe.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_BLOCKER_REVEALED: The wraith presented the spacecraft the inhabitants of the Stranger used to block the Eye of the Universe's signal.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_BLOCKER_JAMMING: The signal blocker prevents signals from the Eye of the Universe from escaping.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_BLOCKER_SIGNAL: The signal blocker emits its own specific signal, which the ringed planet could detect if another antenna also picked up the signal.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_BLOCKER_WORK: The inhabitant who rescued the wraith worked on the signal blocker. She had her own desk in the workroom there, and the picture frame above it has been highlighted.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_DIORAMA_BLOCKER_HOME: The wraith's rescuer left a vision torch behind in her house before she fled the Stranger.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CRASH_VISITED: I found a crash site on Hollow's Lantern where one of the inhabitants of the Stranger apparently died.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CRASH_VISION: I watched the vision left behind by the dead inhabitant. She fled the Stranger with a another creature in hopes of finding the Eye of the Universe. These "wraiths" coexisted alongside the Stranger's inhabitants before being sealed away to power the ship's mechanisms.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WRAITH_PLANET: After absorbing something from the vision torch, the wraith disappeared and a ringed planet appeared in the sky.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_SLATE_INTRO_HEARD: Slate offered me their new "compass" tool. It can scan exotic energy sources and track those frequencies to find similar objects elsewhere in the solar system. A couple of strange objects were left at the campsite for me to try it out with.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_HELPER_HOME: The wraith's rescuer left a vision torch behind in her house before she fled.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_LOCKED_HOUSE_VISION: I watched the vision left behind by the wraith's rescuer. A slide reel was forcibly taken from her and thrown into the river, where it floated downstream before sinking.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_HELPER_WORK: The inhabitant who rescued the wraith worked on the signal blocker. She had her own desk in the workroom there, and the wraith highlighted the picture frame above it.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_BLOCKER_EXPLORED: I found the room where the signal blocker was monitored. The controls are damaged but the systems are otherwise intact.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_HELPER_PORTRAIT: There is a picture of the wraith's rescuer above her desk. It appears to be a photo taken somewhere in the Stranger's interior.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_SUBMERGED_REEL_MISSING: A slide reel was dropped into the water and floated downstream before sinking.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_SUBMERGED_REEL_FOUND: I found the slide reel that had been thrown into the river.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_SUBMERGED_REEL_VIEWED: The slide reel appears to be some kind of error report. An antenna on the exterior of the Stranger is damaged.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_ANTENNA_KNOWN: There is a damaged antenna on the dark side of the Stranger, roughly opposite the hangar.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_ANTENNA_REPAIRED: I am able to repair the damaged antenna from the outside.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_BACKUP_CRYSTAL_NEEDED: The wraith needs a Nomai resonating crystal.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_BACKUP_CRYSTAL_FOUND: I found a Nomai resonating crystal at the Construction Yard island on Giant's Deep.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_TOWER_HINT: The tower in the dream world has something we need to free the other wraiths.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CANDLE_PUZZLE: There are multiple candles on the roof of the tower that I can light or extinguish.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_TOWER_PEEPHOLE: A porthole on the roof of the tower shows a specific clifftop in the real world's Stranger.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_WELL_HOUSE_VISION: A vision torch at the top of the tower pointed me in the direction of a house above the well.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CANDLE_PASSWORD: A slide reel in the house shows a sequence of locations and lit or unlit candles.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CONTROL_ROOM_HINT: The other wraiths are being held in the basement of some sort of control room in the Stranger.
ShipLogDictionary.GFB_CONTROL_ROOM_DISABLED: I was able to cut the power to the simulation, freeing the wraiths.

UIDictionary.GFB_CompassToolScanPrompt: エネルギー測定値をスキャンする
UIDictionary.GFB_CompassFrequency_DreamFire: エキゾチックエアロゾル
